claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised himself as retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, No. 619 Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at 619 Market Street, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: No. 619 Market street. Free concert every evening. West of singers only engaged

notes: Advertisement in Sporting Notes; the date is the day the ad ran. The 'West of singers' wording is OCR for 'Best of singers'.
